title: CareerForge BD
subtitle: Career Platform
description: A full-stack AI-powered career development platform helping job seekers analyze their CVs, close skill gaps, and prepare for their target roles through a guided, data-driven roadmap.
overview: CareerForge BD is a comprehensive career development platform built to help job seekers in Bangladesh understand where they stand and what they need to improve to become career-ready. Users can upload their CV for AI-powered ATS analysis, get personalized skill gap reports, follow a tailored career roadmap with weekly tests, practice with AI mock interviews, and earn skill certificates. Administrators manage users, subscriptions, and platform content through a dedicated dashboard, while a secure Stripe-powered subscription system unlocks premium features.
highlights: AI-powered CV analysis with ATS scoring, keyword matching, and STAR-format rewrites
Skill gap detection mapped against target job roles
Personalized career roadmap engine with weekly tests, final exams, and a readiness score
AI mock interview module with automated feedback and result history
Skill-based certification tests with downloadable certificates
Secure Firebase authentication with role-based access control for Users and Admins
Stripe-integrated subscription and payment system with billing history
Cloudinary-powered document and media handling
Job search functionality with filtering
Responsive, animated dashboards built with Framer Motion
Rate-limited, hardened backend using Helmet and Express Rate Limit
API documentation via Swagger/OpenAPI
role: Team Lead and Full Stack Developer

title: FixIt Now
subtitle: Home Services Booking Platform
description: A full-stack home services booking platform connecting customers with verified technicians, featuring role-based dashboards, live booking tracking, and secure Stripe payments.
overview: FixIt Now is a home services marketplace that connects customers with vetted, verified technicians for plumbing, electrics, AC repair and more across Dhaka. Customers can browse services by category, book a technician for a chosen time slot, pay securely through Stripe Checkout, and track their job through a live status timeline. Technicians manage their service offerings, weekly availability, and incoming bookings, while admins get a full command center to oversee users, categories, and every booking on the platform.
highlights: Secure Stripe Checkout payments with automatic status polling and confirmation
Role-based dashboards for customers, technicians, and administrators
Custom JWT middleware proxy guarding every route by user role
Live booking lifecycle tracking from request to completion
Technician availability and service management with optimistic UI updates
Admin control panel for managing users, categories, and bookings
Post-job review system with ratings and comments
Server-rendered architecture using Next.js App Router and Server Actions
Responsive design across all screen sizes

title: BuyNest
subtitle: E-Commerce Platform
description: A full-stack MERN e-commerce platform with secure authentication, AI-powered support, and integrated online payments.
overview: BuyNest is a modern e-commerce platform designed to provide customers with a secure, fast, and user-friendly online shopping experience. The platform enables users to browse products, manage shopping carts, complete secure SSLCommerz payments, and download PDF invoices. Administrators have dedicated dashboards for managing products, users, and orders, while an AI-powered Gemini chatbot enhances customer support and engagement.
highlights: Secure checkout with SSLCommerz payment integration
Role-based dashboards for customers and administrators
AI-powered chatbot using Gemini API
Automatic PDF invoice generation
Product, order, and user management
Admin control panel for platform management
User authentication and authorization
Responsive design for all screen sizes

title: Skill Nova
subtitle: E-Learning Platform
description: A complete MERN stack e-learning platform with role-based dashboards for students, instructors, and admins. Students can browse courses, enroll, submit assignments, and track progress.
overview: Skill Nova is a proper LMS built to connect students and instructors in one streamlined space. Students can explore available courses, enroll with a click,student can pay to enroll and can download the reciept of payment. They submit assignments, and track their learning progress in real time. Instructors get tools to publish courses and manage submissions, while admins oversee the platform through a dedicated control panel.
highlights: Real-time course management for instructors
Secured Payment integration for course enrollment with stripe
Dedicated dashboards for students, instructors, and admins
Assignment submission and progress tracking for students
Responsive UI for learning on any device
Admin control panel for platform management
